purpose: Root-cause-corrected C-entry parity repair: equal-new-budget course with class-pattern-guarded permutation, both arms rebuilt on the same stream.

root_cause_being_repaired.statement: course1's A+A+B multiset yields only three class patterns; the anchored permutation [1,0,2] swaps two delta-equivalent A members, so it is equivalent to the identity even though it is not the identity. Parent convergence was refuted (delta norms 0.196/0.030 nonzero).
root_cause_being_repaired.implies: repair = make class-pattern collision negligible (n_new balanced over classes + pattern guard), not restore gradients

course_contract.recover_class_excluded_because: K2 worker goal vocabulary lacks goal:recover-target (2 goals only); feeding recover-target transition examples would fail the K2 fit contract
course_contract.identity_minting: per-experience first-file content variant appended as a comment line; byte-length-level changes are invisible to the typed fact masks, so the delta class is preserved while the observation digest is genuinely unique
course_contract.permutation_guard: anchored_permutation(class_keys=...) regenerates deterministically until the anchored class pattern differs from the forward pattern; single-class courses are rejected
course_contract.model_dimension_note: the three model seeds' parent K worker weights are bit-identical (state_dict diff 0.0); the model dimension is a permutation witness, not an independent sample

training_budget_contract.caliber: new_update_steps only (inherited parent training steps are reported separately and excluded from parity comparison)
training_budget_contract.composition: 150 experiences x 2 workers x 2 instances (widened channels / fixed-large replicas)

hard_gates.new_update_steps: exact equality per cell at 600 per arm
hard_gates.class_pattern_changed: anchored pattern differs from forward pattern in every cell
hard_gates.divergence: channel divergence strictly positive for both workers in every cell
hard_gates.fresh_restore: both arms restore from disk with identical owner digests

stop_conditions: any hard gate fails -> stop, attribute per cell, no threshold relaxation
zero divergence under the new course -> stop, attribute experience generation diversity
sealed scoring remains locked until a separate formal preregistration is frozen
can_promote stays false regardless of outcome
